_how: Written by viewing contact sheets of each clip (frames listed in README 'Eyeball checks') BEFORE looking at any algorithm output. label classes: FALL (fast stand-to-floor), LIE (person on a lying posture, no fast fall), NO_ALARM (nobody reaches the floor posture; sat/seated/standing only).

skate_fall.label: FALL
skate_fall.frames_viewed: contact sheet every 0.2 s from 4.8 to 7.6 s: 5.0 on the board crouched (full body), 5.4-6.2 only legs in view (camera tilted down, feet on or just off the board), 6.4 both feet in the air above the board, 6.6 tumbling, 6.8 hand on the ground, 7.0 sprawled on the ground, 7.2-7.4 flat
skate_fall.note: skater on the board until ~6.0 s, airborne/tumbling 6.4-6.8 s, hands hit the ground ~6.9 s, flat on the ground 7.2-7.8 s, rolls out of frame (camera pan) ~8.0 s; nothing on the ground after 8.4 s. The 3.8-4.6 s section is the skater riding upright, NOT the fall.

floor_lie.label: LIE
floor_lie.note: woman lying on a white floor with a cardboard sign for the whole 2.8 s; never upright in the clip, no transition.

assist_elderly.label: LIE
assist_elderly.note: older man lying on a bed (pillow, blanket) the whole 9.6 s, a carer touches his forehead and chin; no fall, no upright phase.

help_sit.label: NO_ALARM
help_sit.note: man seen from behind is helped to stand (head cut off by the frame until ~6 s) and lowered into a wicker chair 5.8-7.4 s by two carers (slow, supported), seated from ~7.6 s. Never reaches the floor.

sit_down.label: NO_ALARM
sit_down.note: portrait clip: man sits on a brick wall for the whole 10 s (puts a hat on, shifts his weight). There is no stand-to-sit transition in the footage despite the title; seated throughout.

classroom.label: NO_ALARM
classroom.note: four people seated at tables; the man at the front table stands up ~4.5-6 s, stays standing beside the table until ~15.5 s and sits again by ~17-18 s; a student further back stands up ~20.5 s and is still standing at 25.5 s. Nobody falls, collapses or lies down.

_on_floor: on_floor: is anybody lying on the floor/ground in the frame the Cosmos check sees (a bed is not the floor).
